verdict.rationale: Viam is a developer platform with public APIs, so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair question. The evidence does not show one: the OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The gRPC transport, the llms.txt file and CLI JSON I/O are adjacent features, not a published API specification such as protobuf definitions offered for download.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
